title: Returns Desk Reference: Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards as Original Tender
content:
When merchandise paid with one of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards comes back, the card kind that paid decides whether the refund is placed back onto a card and onto which kind; the Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card additionally carries its qualifying-purchase terms; and the Merchandise Credit Card records whether the identification taken at a no-receipt return is linked to it.

## Refund onto a card

| Card kind that paid | Refunded back onto a card | Kind of card the refund is placed on |
|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Yes | Merchandise Credit Card |
| Marlowe & Finch eGift Card | Yes | Merchandise Credit Card |
| Merchandise Credit Card | Yes | Merchandise Credit Card |
| Registry Reward Card | Yes | Merchandise Credit Card |
| Corporate Gift Card | Yes | Merchandise Credit Card |
| Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | No | Not applicable |

## Qualifying-purchase terms and identification record

| Card kind | Forfeited or deducted when its qualifying purchase is returned | Qualifying purchase amount | Value per qualifying purchase step | Government ID from a no-receipt return linked to the card |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |
| Marlowe & Finch eGift Card | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |
| Merchandise Credit Card | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | Yes |
| Registry Reward Card | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |
| Corporate Gift Card | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | No |
| Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | Yes | $100.00 | $20.00 | No |

## Points of judgement

- A return of merchandise paid with a Marlowe & Finch Gift Card, a Marlowe & Finch eGift Card, a Merchandise Credit Card, a Registry Reward Card or a Corporate Gift Card is refunded onto a card, and that card is a Merchandise Credit Card.
- A return of merchandise paid with a Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card is not refunded onto a card.
- The Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card is the only kind that is forfeited, or whose used value is deducted, when the purchase that earned it is returned. It is earned by a qualifying purchase of $100.00 and is worth $20.00 per qualifying purchase step.
- Only the Merchandise Credit Card links the government ID recorded at a no-receipt return to the card issued.
